discovery_notes: Web search budget (shared) was exhausted after ~37 searches; slider positions 7/8/11/12, Ducks S2 UK page, Christmas 2025 UK sets not pursued. Seen but excluded (year unclear or pre-2025 code 466...): Disney Toys in a Box Mystery Pin Set 438039572647 (GBP 14, 2 of 8; year not stated); Disney Store Pin Advent Calendar 466041620551 (GBP 175); Mickey Mouse Pin, Pin Trading 25th Anniversary 438038211066 (no details); Mickey, Minnie and Goofy Festive LR Pin 438017426337; Runaway Railway Fantasy Parade LE Pin 438018037570; Ducks of Disney Series 2 (EU listing only, EUR 32); Christmas Cookies 2026 advent calendar reportedly on UK collectibles page (US USD 275) but no UK page seen. Disney Magical Collections (UK/EU LE 1100, GBP 16) entries found were all 2024. Series 3 Muppets 25th set surfaced only on disneystore.eu. The 25th anniversary LE sets and sliders are global Disney Store products, not UK-exclusive. No suspicious/instructional web content encountered.
